title: VTC: add access control for standalone mode
description: Who can see a VTCCall via VTCCall/get or /query? When Chat is present, Space/channel permissions cover this. In standalone mode (no Chat binding), the draft says nothing. Add visibility rules: participants can see calls they are/were in, the initiator can see calls they created, and deployment-defined admin roles may see all calls. Non-participants MUST receive notFound for calls they cannot access.
close_reason: Added Access Control section with Chat-bound rules (inherit Space permissions, start_call gate) and standalone rules (participants-only visibility, notFound for non-participants).
